results.title: Ace
results.overview: Kannan,  with a past comes to Malaysia to turn over a new leaf. But when he realises that the girl he loves needs money to get out of a difficult situation, he commits a robbery that makes him the target of a fearsome gangster and the girl’s stepfather, an immoral cop.

results.title: Don't Forget to Smile
results.overview: A teacher teaching kids how to smile in a dystopian world.

results.title: Underground Morphology
results.overview: Sidka, a filmmaker in the process of gender transition, explores the vibrant nightlife of Buenos Aires, capturing the essence of underground culture and the deep connections that celebrate acceptance and self-expression.

results.title: Emergency
results.overview: A raging bush fire, a trapped secret agent and no way out. Daisy calls for help only to discover she has to rely on the one person she doesn't trust. Will she make it out?

results.title: Chris Gethard: A Father and the Sun
results.original_title: Chris Gethard: A Father and the Sun
results.overview: Chris Gethard - who Time Magazine recently said is “a self-deprecating, punk-rock-loving New Jersey native who offers a master class in empathy, compassion, and kindness” - returns in a thoughtful and hard-hitting new show. Known for the critically acclaimed special Career Suicide as well as his unforgettable characters in shows like The Office and Broad City, Gethard is currently taking on his most prolific role yet: as a father. Charting the emotional experiences and revelations each new parent faces, A Father and the Sun is a hilarious ride bursting with palpable punchlines as Gethard tenderly explores generational differences, masculinity, what it means to be a dad, and the truly unexpected joys of lawn maintenance.

results.title: Stardom New Blood 24
results.original_title: プロレスファン必携アプリSTOMPING Presents NEW BLOOD 24
results.overview: New Blood 24 was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on October 4, 2025, at Belle Salle Shinjuku Grand Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Stardom 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Matsumoto
results.original_title: 第15回 ゴッデス・オブ・スターダム ～タッグリーグ戦～ in MATSUMOTO
results.overview: 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League in Matsumoto was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It took place on November 9, 2025, at Kissei Bunka Hall in Matsumoto, Nagano, Japan, and served as the 3rd show of the tournament's tour.

results.title: El novio
results.overview: On his wedding day, Diego locks himself in the sacristy, unable to marry Elmira. A visit from Salva will give him the courage he needs to be able to continue with what he “must do”.

results.title: The long february - What happened in Bucha?
results.original_title: Der lange Februar - Das Klagelied von Butscha
results.overview: The Long February tells the story of the Russian occupation of the Bucha region through the eyes of those who survived it. Combining testimonies of civilians, police officers and artists with private footage shared by the participants themselves and archival material, the film explores not only the occupation itself but also its lasting human consequences. Rather than ending with Bucha's liberation, The Long February examines memory, trauma and resilience, revealing how the war continues to shape the lives of Bucha's residents.

results.title: Citizen of the Sun
results.overview: Brothers Tarmo and Toomas Urb are musicians whose phenomenon in 1980s Estonia is hard to overestimate. Performing romantic ballads accompanied by guitar, they were able to bring a full house to any concert hall. Some songs like "Imeline laas" or "Musta pori näkku" have become folklore. The brothers were compared to the duo Simon & Garfunkel.

results.title: Museo de la subversión
results.overview: The discovery of several tapes recorded in 1985, during the "Trials of the Juntas," inside the Anti-Subversive Museum of Buenos Aires, allows for a rare reconstruction of the dictatorship's discourse and reveals the residual power of the military even under democracy. This film illuminates a particularly dark historical period and creates a tension: the exposure of the dictatorship's triumphalist rhetoric and the mannequins as a spectral presence of the disappeared.

results.title: Kaede
results.overview: A twin secretly replaces his deceased brother to stay with his lover, hiding the truth while falling for her and navigating suspicions and her hidden secret.

results.title: Muganga
results.overview: Denis Mukwege, a Congolese doctor, pastor and future Nobel Peace Prize laureate, meets Guy Cadière, a Belgian surgeon and atheist. Despite their differences, they unite for a common purpose: to restore the bodies and dignity of thousands of women who have been used as weapons of war in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.

results.title: Senkoh: Spark the Dream
results.original_title: Senkoh ตบสนั่นฝันประกาย
results.overview: Shin and Joe, former ping-pong rivals who once faced each other in a national youth match, meet again years later on very different paths from the dreams they once had. They decide to play together once more — in an empty practice room, a match with no score, no audience, and nothing at stake. Yet through the quiet rhythm of the rally, they begin to revisit their past, listen to each other’s hearts, and rediscover what the game truly means to them.

results.title: Rolle Workshop, a Journey
results.overview: A micro-macroscopic journey through Jean-Luc Godard's Rolle studio, a place of light and shadow and a tree of thoughts: the inner forest of cinema.

results.title: Star Academy : Les coulisses du château
results.original_title: Star Academy : Les coulisses du château

results.title: Kuncen
results.overview: After 24 hours without news from her boyfriend who was climbing a mountain, Awindya, a high school girl, was determined to invite her two friends, Agnes and Mojo to follow her boyfriend to Mount Merbabu. Upon arrival, the caretaker or Kuncen of the mountain had died tragically due to black magic. Together with two other people, Yoga and Diska, who also lost their closest people on the mountain, they agreed to find out who the new Kuncen was in order to find their missing friends. It is said that according to local beliefs, without a Kuncen, the mountain is a place that holds mysteries and all supernatural creatures succeed in terrorizing those who dare to enter it. Will they succeed in finding the successor of the guardian; the Kuncen of the Mountain?

results.title: Nada a Fazer
results.overview: Follows the transformation in the mother-daughter relationship of Brazilian actresses Angela and Leandra Leal while confined during the COVID-19 pandemic.

results.title: ParaNorman: The Thrifting
results.overview: When Norman, Courtney, and Neil stumble into a creepy curiosity shop, paranormal chaos ensues...
